messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — proposed cutover for slate-13b-quantv2 (catalog enable) TOMORROW 10:00 PST. Change window 10:00-11:30. Need release + ops ack and a pinned rollback plan.
kevin: Ack, can we confirm canary sizing? last time 5% caused noisy latency spikes.
sam: Proposal: 3-step roll (5% canary -> 25% warm -> 100%) with 20m observation between steps. Canary nodes will be isolated to eu-west-1 for initial telemetry.
ira: +1. Telemetry gates: token latency p50 > 220ms OR error-rate increase > 0.8% triggers immediate rollback to pinned version. Also add model-quality alert: chat-quality eval drift > 1.5% on smoke prompts.
maria: Good. For VIP customers we should pin legacy model (slate-13b-v1) at edge so they don't get switched. I'll add pin list to the enable payload.
kevin: How are we handling fallback ordering? Current ladder sometimes routes to degen-7b first which increases hallucination in some flows. We should bump legacy-13b above degen-7b for this rollout.
sam: Agreed — new fallback ordering for this catalog scope: slate-13b-quantv2 -> slate-13b-v1 (pinned) -> degen-7b -> tiny-fallback. I'll paste the patch:
```json
{
  "catalog_entry": "slate-13b-quantv2",
  "fallback_priority": ["slate-13b-v1","degen-7b","tiny-fallback"],
  "pin_list": ["acct:enterprise-42","acct:gov-test"]
}
```
ira: Make sure the deploybot has the correct priority list field name: fallback_priority_list vs fallback_priority — mismatch caused a no-op once. ops-oncall we should verify on the dry-run.
ops-oncall: I'll run a dry-run tonight 22:00 PST in staging. Will verify pin behavior and fallback ordering by hitting the catalog router with test keys. Ping me if you want to watch.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduling catalog enable job -> job_id=job-2026-04-03-304; window=2026-04-03T17:00:00Z; operator=maria. Will perform staged traffic shift: 5% at t+10m, 25% at t+40m, 100% at t+70m if gates pass.
sre-oncall: I'll be oncall for the window. If p95 latency > 600ms or error-rate delta > 1.5% escalate to sec-ops and trigger rollback.
kevin: Rollback plan: immediate switch: set catalog pin to slate-13b-v1 and move traffic back using deploy-bot rollback command. Command: `deploy-bot rollback job-2026-04-03-304 --target slate-13b-v1 --reason "latency/regression"`
sam: Add postmortem hook: if rollback occurs, capture gating metrics and a 30-min trace sample and run the quick-eval suite (50 prompts) to measure quality delta.
maria: Release notes draft to send to customers after stable cutover: short blurb about improved memory footprint and cost with quantv2, mention pinned rollbacks & canary, and include contact for perf regressions. I'll draft and share.
ira: One more ops nit: ensure autoscale headroom in eu-west-1 is +30% for first hour. Quant variant uses more RAM on GPU, we saw OOM risk last time.
kevin: Noted. Infrastructure will set max_instances = current + 30% for plaza-nodepool-eu-west1 for the window.
ops-oncall: Dry-run completed: pin list applied, fallback ordering respected. Two small issues: metrics tag key was `model.variant` not `model_variant` — fixed in staging and will patch in release manifests.
maria: Thanks. All good from product side. Final checks: 1) release doc posted in #release-notes by 08:00 PST tomorrow 2) ops oncall + sre-oncall present 3) deploy-bot scheduled.
kevin: I'm available for the window.
sre-oncall: I'll watch telemetry dashboards and have rollback privileges.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Job job-2026-04-03-304 queued. Preflight status: checks_passed=7/7 (auth, pinlist, fallback_order, telemetry_hooks, autoscale, dry_run, quota). Reply `:thumbsup:` to confirm running.
maria: :thumbsup: running.
kevin: :thumbsup:
ops-oncall: :thumbsup:
ira: :thumbsup:
maria: Post-cutover plan: monitor 90m, then remove temporary higher headroom and update catalog docs. If no regressions after 24h we'll mark as GA and add to model catalog page.
kevin: One final ask — include the exact canary keys we'll use so support can correlate logs. Canaries: keyset canary-slate-01..03.
sam: Added to release doc. OK to close?
maria: Closing thread. Thanks team — see you in the changewindow.
